normal.no: Nope, I've got a reason to be here

normal.text: Are you opening this on a reflex?
Are you here with time to kill, not a reason?

annoyed.text: Again? Are you looking away from something?
Third time today. Are you still just checking one thing?
Are you back for the same thing, and the same feeling after?

brutal.text: Sixth time. Are you sure you're the one opening the app?
Are you here for permission you already know the answer to?
Are you about to lose another hour you won't remember?
